objective: Determine how MPNST tumour cells interact with immune and other TME populations, identify recurrent and biologically plausible signalling circuits, establish which findings are concordant across independent CCC frameworks, and connect candidate tumour-derived signals to receiver-cell transcriptional states.

ccc_input_object.rationale: The SCT assay carries four SCTransform models so SCT values are not on a common footing across samples. Harmony coordinates are never used as expression.

populations_excluded.reason: flagged not CCC-ready in the Phase 2 M15A audit

minimum_cell_policy.basis: CellChat's min.cells default and the conventional floor for per-group mean-expression estimates
minimum_cell_policy.absence_rule: A population below the minimum is recorded NOT EVALUABLE, never as absence of signalling.
minimum_cell_policy.outcome: all 14 populations and all 182 directed pairs evaluable in all 4 samples

LIANA.input_route: SingleCellExperiment (liana 0.1.14's Seurat path uses the defunct GetAssayData(slot=); SeuratObject was NOT downgraded)

CellChat.support_rule: present in subsetCommunication() output (significant links only)
CellChat.execution: one SLURM job per sample (parallelism; identical results)

CellPhoneDB.support_rule: permutation p < 0.05 AND mean expression > 0 in >=1 sample

NicheNet.role: receiver-response modelling, NOT a fourth LR framework
NicheNet.gene_set_of_interest: receiver population marker genes (cluster characterisation, NOT condition DE)

LochNESS.role: orthogonal transcriptional-neighbourhood phenotype; NOT a ligand-receptor method

no_score_averaging: Raw scores are never averaged across tools. Each LR framework contributes a boolean support flag only. NicheNet enters as orthogonal receiver-response support, never as a fourth LR vote.
known_partial_non_independence: LIANA's method set includes a CellPhoneDB-style score, so LIANA and the standalone CellPhoneDB run are not fully independent.

class_definitions.High concordance: supported by all frameworks that could test it (>=2)
class_definitions.Single-method: supported by the ONLY framework whose resource contained it
class_definitions.Discordant/ambiguous: testable by >=2 frameworks but supported by only 1 - genuine disagreement

prioritisation.rule: lexicographic tiers on concordance, sample recurrence and expression support; no weighted composite

evidence_integration.lochness_role: receiver-LINEAGE-level context; not interaction-specific and never LR evidence

lochness_results.conclusion: No receiver lineage shows neighbourhood structure associated with the tumour-derived APP signalling context beyond chance. A legitimate negative result.

implementation_comparison.conclusion: The implementations are numerically identical given mathematically equivalent inputs. The perturb-seq formulation diverges because it omits same-sample exclusion.

environment.r_env: R 4.4.3; Seurat 5.4.0; SeuratObject 5.3.0; harmony 1.2.4; Matrix 1.7.4 (all unchanged from Phase 2)

scientific_caveats: scRNA-seq ligand-receptor analysis infers communication POTENTIAL from expression and associated transcriptional programmes. It does not establish physical cell adjacency or direct signalling.
sample_id is simultaneously the dataset, the patient and the batch. No between-tumour or condition-level claim is supportable.
No biological-condition variable exists, so no condition-level CCC comparison was possible and none was fabricated.
53.6% of supported interactions are supported in only one patient; these are reported, not discarded.
Most interaction keys (488,435 of 502,846) exist in only one framework's LR resource, so 'single-method' usually reflects resource non-overlap rather than disagreement.
LIANA and CellPhoneDB are not fully independent (LIANA includes a CellPhoneDB-style score).

LochNESS found no receiver-state structure associated with the tumour-derived APP context beyond chance, and the score is unstable across embeddings (Spearman 0.02-0.42) and reference samples (0.31-0.50).
With four samples the exact sample-level permutation null has a p-value floor of 1/6 = 0.167, so all LochNESS permutation results are descriptive ranks, not significance tests.
The Phase 2 malignant fraction is itself uncertain (17.35% conservatively, up to ~49% if the fibroblast clusters are Mes-NC-like malignant), which propagates into every tumour-centric CCC result.
NicheNet did not rank APP among the top ligands explaining the macrophage programme, despite APP-CD74 being the strongest LR co-expression finding. This divergence is reported, not reconciled.
prohibitions_respected: no pseudobulk condition DE unrelated to receiver-response
no CCC method executed beyond inference (no Phase 4 spatial work)
